## 🧠 Synapse Pull Request

### 📋 Description
Provide a clear and concise description of what this PR does. If it fixes a bug, please link the issue.

- **Issue:** Fixes #
- **Component:** [e.g. Indexer, MCP, CLI, Wiki]

### 🛠️ Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 **Bug Fix** (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ **New Feature** (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 **Breaking Change** (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📚 **Documentation** (updates to README, wiki, or docs)
- [ ] 🎨 **Refactor** (code cleanup with no functional changes)

### 🧪 Testing Strategy
Describe the tests you ran to verify your changes. Include steps to reproduce if applicable.

- [ ] **Unit Tests:** `pytest tests/test_specific.py`
- [ ] **Integration Tests:** `synapse doctor` and `synapse mcp verify`
- [ ] **Manual Verification:** Describe the manual steps taken.

### ✅ Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the **Deterministic-First** philosophy of Synapse.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation according to my changes.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally.
- [ ] I have checked for potential performance regressions in the Indexer.
